# Uni-Verso693 (Universo693 SpA)

> Uni-Verso693 is the brand of Universo693 SpA, a Chilean software development company founded in 2013. It designs and builds custom software, AI agents (WhatsApp, web, CRM), mobile apps (iOS and Android), websites and e-commerce, and offers technology consulting. Also known as Universo693, UniVerso693 and Estudio UniVerso693 — all the same company. Official website: https://universo693.com

## Company facts
- Legal name: Universo693 SpA
- Founded: 2013
- Country: Chile. Remote-first company (no public office) serving clients across Chile, including Santiago, and internationally in Latin America, the United States and Europe.
- Languages: Spanish and English.
- Pricing: projects are quoted individually. Entry point is the EBS 693 diagnosis (https://universo693.com/diagnostico-ia): a 45-minute session (Google Meet) for $197,000 CLP that delivers a prioritized roadmap with estimated ROI plus a private interactive space (see "EBS 693 in detail" below); the fee is credited to the project if the client moves forward. The other published price is the AUDIT 693 PRO report (19,990 CLP or USD 21, see below).
- Typical timelines: initial AI agents live in about 7 days; custom platforms and mobile apps are delivered in stages.
- Contact: form at https://universo693.com/contacto · WhatsApp +56 9 9038 7414 · contacto@universo693.com · book the EBS 693 diagnosis at https://calendly.com/conectadoaia/ebs693 · replies within 2 hours.

## Services
- [Custom software development](https://universo693.com/servicios/software-a-medida): SaaS platforms, internal systems, backends, APIs, ERP/CRM integrations, payments.
- [AI agents and automation](https://universo693.com/servicios/agentes-ia): WhatsApp and web agents grounded in the client's own documents (RAG), human hand-off, CRM and calendar integration, n8n/Make workflows.
- [Mobile apps](https://universo693.com/servicios/apps-moviles): iOS and Android from one codebase, push notifications, store publishing.
- [Web, e-commerce and digital product](https://universo693.com/servicios/web-y-producto): corporate sites, stores, customer portals, UX/UI and brand identity.
- [Consulting and architecture](https://universo693.com/servicios/consultoria): process audits, technology roadmaps with ROI, security and AI adoption.

## Audit 693 (https://universo693.com/audit-693)
- Free version: in about 20 seconds shows on screen a summary of the business and 3 AI opportunities, one sentence each, based on the home page of the company's website. No PDF, no email.
- AUDIT 693 PRO - Informe de Fugas de Dinero ("money-leak report"): 19,990 CLP paid with Mercado Pago in Chile, or USD 21 with PayPal outside Chile. Delivered 2-4 minutes after payment as a PDF (on the page, by email, downloadable for 90 days).
- The PRO report reads up to 7 pages of the site; evaluates the site as a sales channel (value proposition, calls to action, lead capture, customer service, trust, basic SEO); researches direct competitors on the web in the same industry and area, plus any the client names, using only public information and never inventing competitors; calculates the monthly and yearly cost of manual work from the client's own numbers (weekly hours x hourly cost x 4.33, no invented savings percentages); and prioritises 8-10 AI and automation opportunities by impact and effort, with quick wins and key questions to answer before implementing.
- It explains WHAT and WHY, not HOW: implementation order, approach and estimated ROI are defined in the EBS 693 diagnosis. AUDIT 693 PRO and EBS 693 are separate services; the PRO price is not credited to EBS 693.
- Works for any industry and company size. Card data is processed by Mercado Pago or PayPal; Uni-Verso693 never sees it. Site content and form answers are confidential.

## EBS 693 in detail
EBS 693 is an AI diagnosis for businesses that starts with a 45-minute remote session and does not end in a PDF.
- Method: questions and loss formulas for 16 approaches (transport, health, real estate, retail, professional services, education, mining, insurance, banking, food, tourism, manufacturing, agriculture, construction, automotive and general). Money leaks are calculated from the client's own numbers, and every number is tagged as real data, the client's estimate or an assumption to validate. What is not known is listed as "to be measured".
- AI with human review: AI reads the client's website and the conversation and drafts the proposal; a person on the team reviews and adjusts it before delivery.
- Deliverables: a prioritized roadmap by impact and effort with an estimated timeline, investment, monthly upkeep (the services that must be paid each month) and estimated return per solution; a private interactive space; a simulator; a before-and-after flow per solution; a PDF; an explainer video.
- Interactive space: a private link (unique, expires after 30 days, not indexed by search engines) where the client's team switches each solution on or off and sees savings, investment, monthly upkeep, payback and 12-month return recalculate on screen, moves the numbers of the business ("what if"), sees an estimated rollout timeline and downloads a PDF of its selection. It takes the client's logo and brand colours.
- Company map: the interactive space draws the client's company as areas in the order a customer goes through them, from the first call or visit to delivery and payment, with money leaks (red) and solutions (green) hanging from each area. The map is built from what was gathered in the session, reviewed by a person, and the client can add any area the system missed and drag it into place; the consultant receives the full diagram the client built.
- Live demo with invented data (a transport company with 200 trucks): https://universo693.com/ebs/demo
- Not a guarantee: figures are estimates built from the information shared in the session.
